programme.title: Бабушка лёгкого поведения
programme.desc: Мастер перевоплощений Саня по прозвищу Трансформер провернул кучу афер, точь-в-точь изображая десятки персонажей. Но в этот раз он украл не у тех… Теперь у парня на хвосте очень плохие люди с пистолетами. Саня решает залечь на дно в доме престарелых в образе пожилой тети. И когда ему казалось, что он попал в безвыходную ситуацию, новый поворот судьбы дарит ему любовь и надежду превратиться в приличного человека.

programme.title: Легенды наших предков
programme.desc: Репортер из Екатеринбурга по заданию редакции оказывается в затерянном в тайге селении, где слышит старинное предание о владыке леса. По возвращении домой он внезапно начинает видеть и слышать этого древнего духа, который просит спасти исчезающих фантастических созданий. Журналист соглашается, и вместе с 12-летней дочерью, приехавшей к нему на каникулы из Москвы, отправляется в края, почти не тронутые цивилизацией.

programme.title: Бабушка лёгкого поведения 2. Престарелые мстители
programme.desc: В продолжении популярной комедии зрителей вновь ждет встреча с обаятельным аферистом Сашей Рубенштейном и командой пенсионеров, которые теперь перебрались в Москву. Но их счастливой жизни приходит конец, когда банк, в котором хранятся все сбережения стариков, банкротит беспринципный олигарх Бородин. Саша и \"ОПГ - организованная пенсионная группировка\" опять объединяются, чтобы отомстить обидчику.

programme.title: Мама
programme.desc: Началась эта история давно. Потеряв мужа, который попал в тюрьму из-за кражи угля и был убит во время побега, Полина, мать шестерых детей, осталась без всякой поддержки. Чтобы как-то свести концы с концами, Полина основала семейный фольклорный ансамбль. Но вскоре мама поняла, что ее дети достойны лучшей участи, и приняла отчаянное решение угнать самолет за границу… Через пятнадцать лет Полина выйдет из тюрьмы и узнает, что судьба разбросала детей по всей стране: кто-то воюет в горячей точке, кто-то рубит уголь в Донбассе, а самый старший — Лёнчик — по-прежнему в лечебнице для душевнобольных — ведь тогда, 15 лет назад, он прикинулся ненормальным. И сегодня мама вновь собирает своих сыновей, чтобы освободить старшего брата из психушки.

programme.title: Щит Минервы
programme.desc: Автор популярных романов Влад узнаёт, что жена собирается оставить его ради другого мужчины. Чтобы удержать любимую женщину рядом, он инсценирует травму, делающую его инвалидом, веря, что она не оставит его в таком состоянии. Вопреки всему он надеется вернуть свою любовь. Там где у обычных людей кончается фантазия, у писателя начинается реальность. Природа этих странных отношений становится материалом для его нового романа \"Щит Минервы\".

programme.title: Репетиции
programme.desc: Театральный художник Александра и талантливый актер Игорь - красивая молодая пара. Они живут вместе, но ежедневно, \"на завтра\" откладывают самые важные вопросы- семьи, детей, принятия решений. Мегаполис диктует бешеный ритм жизни. Работа, секс, премьеры, встречи дарят опасную иллюзию, что настоящее- всего лишь репетиция, и завтра все можно будет переиграть заново. Не желая уезжать с Игорем на другой конец света, Александра решается на новый роман. Очередные \"репетиции\", как ей кажется, проходят удачно, но внезапно меняется задуманный сценарий.

programme.title: American Traitor
programme.desc: Based on a true story. Eccentric, brilliant lawyer James Laughlin (Al Pacino) boldly accepts the case to defend American entertainer Mildred Gillars (Meadow Williams) from ten counts of treason charged by the US government regardless of the inevitable backlash from his country. During WWII, Mildred became a powerful weapon in the hands of the Nazis and was forced to sing defeatist war propaganda to US soldiers based in Europe. Terrorized and raped by Joseph Goebbels, Hitler's right-hand man, Mildred broadcasts hate-filled messages in order to survive the dark and dangerous world of the Third Reich. Despite attempting to murder Goebbels, Mildred is eventually captured by American authorities and sent to trial where, against all odds, Laughlin struggles to redeem her reputation and maintain his own.

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond, a money launderer struggling with memory loss sustained in a car crash, goes on the run, evading the police while carrying heaps of stolen cash he knows nothing about. Moe and his partner in crime Bobby "Skunk" Cohen had been given a job by Bobby's uncle Perico, wherein he gave them a sum of $20 million to launder. However, the two are ambushed while doing a side job by corrupt police officers. The two manage to escape the cops, but soon after end up in a car accident.

programme.title: The War Is Over
programme.desc: Following the bombardment of Kosovo in 1999, the Rahmanis and their three children emigrate to Switzerland. After years of living in their new homeland, the family faces the prospects of deportation. "No one is proud to be a refugee, but when it comes to me, I am not ashamed of who I am" says Rasim - the father of the family and an ex music teacher. Desperate to stay he invents an Albanian Dance Troupe in order to garner signatures of support from the community… The intimate narrative explores the experience of forced migration: the fraught decision to leave; the process of integration and adaptation to a new country; the impact on the family; and always, the yearning for the homeland.

programme.title: Lost Treasure of Jesse James
programme.desc: A backwoods team of Missouri kids race to solve a 100 year old mystery and save their friends in this family friendly action adventure. Chased deep into ancient caves they must escape treasure hunters hot on their trail or be lost forever.

programme.title: True Smile
programme.desc: Sergio, a 26-year-old autistic male is blind and has never seen a smile. He does, however, give everybody a sincere smile every day. A documentary based on the amazing story encapsulated by Sergio Aznarez Rosado's life.

programme.title: Railroad Tigers
programme.desc: In December 1941, Japan expands the occupation of its neighbouring countries to Southeast Asia. The railway from Tianjin to Nanjing in East China became a key military transportation route, heavily guarded by Japanese soldiers. Railroad worker Ma Yuan (Jackie Chan) leads a team of freedom fighters. Using his deep knowledge of the train network, he and his men sabotage it, ambushing Japanese soldiers and stealing supplies to feed the starving Chinese. Although the freedom fighters have no weapons of their own, they employ whatever tools are at hand, including a hammer and shovels, loose railway track planks and diverted trains. The local Chinese call the unlikely heroes the "Railroad Tigers". The freedom fighters find themselves on the wrong side of the tracks when the Japanese send reinforcements to Shandong. In an act of defiance, Ma Yuan launches his most dangerous mission yet, blowing up a heavily guarded railroad bridge. When the Japanese learn of the crippling plan, which will derail the war effort, the stakes are raised even higher. After many missed opportunities and missed shots, the bridge is blown up by the ragtag Chinese railroad tigers.

programme.title: Score: A Hockey Musical
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Farley has led a sheltered life, raised on a diet of home schooling, organic living and trips to the art gallery. To his parents' dismay, Farley loves to play hockey with the local kids. To their even greater dismay, Farley is scouted and signed by the owner of a junior league team, where he becomes an instant star. But Farley discovers that stardom comes with a price - including the expectation to fight on the ice. Throw in a changing relationship with his best friend, and Farley finds himself losing his way.

programme.title: Wings Of Eagles
programme.desc: The continuing true story of Eric Liddell's glorious life after winning Olympic gold in the 1924 Paris Olympics. Liddell has returned to China, where he was born to missionary parents, modestly avoiding celebrity in order to teach local schoolchildren. In 1937, the Japanese invade China at the outset of WWll. Liddell with his friend Xu Niu, a street smart resistance fighter, recognize the increasing danger so Liddell sends his wife, Florence and their two daughters to safety in Canada. Duty-bound, Liddell stays to minister to the civilian victims. Liddell and other foreign nationals are taken as prisoners and placed in one of the many Japanese internment camps where they are forced to endure for two years. Before the Japanese surrender, Liddell succumbs to a brain tumor. Yet his message of hope became immortal. Eric Liddell's legacy continues to this day as he remains admired as a champion for life.

programme.title: Rat Race
programme.desc: Donald P. Sinclair has placed six separate gold coins in different slot machines in his casino. The lucky six who find these coins discover an opportunity of a lifetime. The chance to own $2 million. Locked up in a locker in New Mexico, these six contestants must now race each other, to be the first to the cash. There are no rules in place and everything that could possibly happen, does. Whilst, behind the scenes, Sinclair's associates are placing their bets.

programme.title: Max Cloud
programme.desc: A space cruiser crash lands on the purple planet of Heinous, an intergalactic prison that is home to the most vile and dangerous villains in the galaxy. All of the crew have perished except for its pilot; intergalactic space hero Max Cloud, the ships hapless chef Jake, and its reluctant Commander, Rexy. Their mission is simple, wait inside their vessel until help arrives and try their best to keep the prisoners outside from getting in, however this is Max Cloud and he doesn't do simple. ...But this is not real life. This is a video-game, and at the helm of the adventure is Sarah, a teenage video game fanatic who immerses herself in fantasy to avoid dealing with her less than packed social life and a strained relationship with her dad, straight laced single parent Tony. After a fallout, Tony bans Sarah from playing games and in a frenzy of teenage emotion Sarah makes a wish, that in the blink of an eye becomes a reality... With a flash of pixelated light Sarah is transported into the video game by the mysterious Space Witch, who exists in an etherial void, behind a secret door, that never appears in the same place twice! So Sarah finds herself trapped inside the game and the only person who can help her is her equally socially defunct but incredibly charming friend, Cowboy, who must control Sarah from her bedroom in Brooklyn and keep her from losing her one life, in a game that can't be paused, that they have never finished before! To make matters worse Sarah has not found herself inside the body of the wonderful Max Cloud, but Jake, that's right... the hapless chef. We follow Sarah as she negotiates the terrifying and dangerous planet of Heinous alongside the ever confident Max and fed up Rexy, jumping back and forth with the real world as the pressure mounts on Cowboy and the real stakes start to rise. They soon encounter stranded Bounty Hunter, Brock Donnelly, and realise they must get off the planet before help arrives as the planets surface burns so hot every day that anything not underground is space liquid! AND to add to the stakes Cowboy must keep his best friend away from the evil clutches of the games villain Revengor, a part man, part machine, lunatic who is hell bent on taking Max Clouds ship and with an army of prisoners and an evil sorcersss called SHEE, his chances look pretty damn good. The action bounces between the video game and the real world as Cowboy and Sarah must come together to get her home, all leading to the ultimate showdown in Revengors lair, where back in Brooklyn, video game expertise arrives in the form of a very unlikely hero. Sit down. Plug in. It's time to play THE INTERGALACTIC ADVENTURES OF MAX CLOUD.

programme.title: Cleanskin
programme.desc: Harry (Sam Douglas), a British people arms dealer, is seen in bed with a prostitute named Rena (Shivani Ghai). While toying with Harry's pistol, she unloads it but replaces the empty magazine. Harry's bodyguard Ewan (Sean Bean) is a British Secret Intelligence Service. Harry and Ewan travel to a bank, transporting a briefcase of Semtex. The men are followed by two terrorists, Ash (Abhin Galeya) and Ibrahim (Mens-Sana Tamakloe). Ibrahim approaches Harry and Ewan from the top of a staircase, shooting at them. After Ash shoots Ewan twice, Harry tries to shoot Ash, only to discover there are no bullets in his gun. Ash kills Harry and takes the briefcase of Semtex. However, Ewan manages to shoot Ash in the arm; but, before he can apprehend him, Ash returns fire and escapes with the briefcase.

programme.title: The Flock
programme.desc: This film is about a hyper-vigilant employee of the department of public safety who, while training his young female replacement, has to track down a missing girl who he is convinced is connected to a paroled sex offender he is investigating.

programme.title: Love Is Not Enough
programme.desc: Samir, must face his parent's breakup. While they meet to find the way to tell him, the little Samir surprises them, because he knows perfectly what's happening, putting his own parents into a hard place with his vision of the situation.

programme.title: Hangman
programme.desc: Mystery movie. American mystery, produced in 2017. Retired homicide detective Ray Archer and his partner, ex FBI agent Will Ruiney, are assigned to track down a vicious serial killer, who is playing a twisted version of the children's game 'Hangman'.

programme.desc: Tšehhi-Šveits-Suurbritannia- USA-Prantsusmaa 2016 märul. Alice Racine (Rapace), raske lapsepõlvega CIA ülekuulaja, elab nüüd Londonis ja töötab seal salaagendina. Järgneb tappev kassi-hiire mäng, mille käigus elu eest võitlev Alice ei tea, keda ta usaldada võib. programme.title: Kolm reklaamtahvlit linna servas
programme.desc: USA/ Suurbritannia 2017 draama, komöödia,krimi Lavastaja:Martin McDonagh Osades:Frances McDormand, Woody Harrelson, Sam Rockwell, Peter Dinklage, Abbie Cornish, Caleb Landry Jones, John Hawkes Mildred Hayes (Oscari-võitja Frances McDormand) on eluraskuste poolt kõvaks keedetud lahutatud naine, keda piinab päevast päeva Missouri väikelinna Ebbingi politsei tegevusetus. Mildredi teismelise tütre mõrva uurimine pole kuhugi välja viinud ning mitme kuu jooksul pole kinni peetud ainsatki kahtlusalust. Naine paneb kohaliku konnatiigi lainetama, rentides linna toova maantee ääres kolm reklaamtahvlit, mille sisu on otseseks väljakutseks kohalikule korrakaitsele, täpsemalt šerif William Willoughbyle (Woody Harrelson). Kui sündmuste käiku sekkub šerifi parem käsi, ebaküps vägivaldne memmekas Dixon (Sam Rockwell), aitab see konflikti lahendamisele kaasa sama edukalt kui bensiiniga täidetud tulekustuti.

programme.title: Kõik kõikjal ja korraga
programme.desc: Maailma saatus on kaalul. Ja mitte ühe maailma, vaid sadade ja tuhandete erinevate paralleeluniversiumite saatus. Suur kurjus on pääsenud lahti ning otsib kõikidest maailmadest taga seda ühte ja ainsat Evelyni, kes oleks suuteline takistama tema õelaid plaane. Selle maailma Evelyn on aga pisikese pesumaja omanik kes küll teab et tal seisab ees tähtis päev, kuid arvab et see peitub kohtumises kurja maksuametnikuga. Just sel hetkel teatab tema mees et ei olegi tema mees, vaid pärit paralleelmaailmast ning usub et just Evelyn on see kes peab nüüd ja kohe maailma päästma.

programme.title: Pianist
programme.desc: Cannes'is Kuldse Palmioksa ja arvukalt Oscareid võitnud filmi aluseks on vahetult pärast II maailmasõda ilmunud Poola helilooja Wladyslaw Szpilmani autobiograafia. Napilt natside surmalaagrist pääsenud juudi soost pianist Szpilman (Adrien Brodyle Oscari toonud roll) elas ennast Varssavi varemetes varjates imekombel üle terve sõja, otsides toitu ja ulualust kust juhtus. Heade inimeste abiga ja muusika toel võib aga üle saada ka kõige hullemast. Oscarid said ka parim mugandatud stsenaarium ja režissöör Roman Polanski.

programme.title: Koerte saar
programme.desc: USA 2018 animatsioon, seikluskomöödia Lavastaja: Wes Anderson Osades(hääled): Frances McDormand, Greta Gerwig, Scarlett Johansson, Bryan Cranston, Edward Norton, Tilda Swinton, Jeff Goldblum, Liev Schreiber, Bill Murray, Harvey Keitel, Ken Watanabe "Koerte saar" on lugu 12-aastasest Atari Kobayashist, kelle eestkostjaks on korrumpeerunud meer Kobayashi. Kui linnapea dekreediga küüditatakse kõik Megasaki City koerad tohutule prügimäele, kihutab Atari oma Junior-Turbo propellerlennukiga Prügisaarele, et päästa oma neljajalgne ihukaitsja Täpi. Koos uute krantsidest sõpradega asub Atari eepilisele teekonnale, millega määratakse terve Prefektuuri tulevik.

programme.title: City Island
programme.desc: Vince on pereinimene, kes teenib elatist järelvalveinspektorina vanglas, kuid sisimas on ta juba lapsepõlvest saati soovinud näitlejaks saada. Häbenedes oma unistust, laseb ta pigem oma naisel uskuda, et ta käib pidevalt pokkerimängudel. Kuid näitlemisklass võib saada Vince'i pereelule saatuslikuks, sest tal palutakse avaldada klassi ees oma elu suurim saladus.

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Женский доктор
programme.desc: Зинаида регулярно получает сообщения с угрозами от неизвестного мужчины. Ее муж Николай, известный меценат, настаивает, чтобы в клинике с его женой был телохранитель Петр. Доктор Родионов слышит, как Петр записывает в коридоре клиники сообщение с угрозами. Роман приводит на осмотр в клинику дочь Раду, желая убедиться, что она не бесплодна. С ним крестная мать Рады Рубина, которая и нагадала бесплодие. Выясняется, что отец Рады решил выдать дочь замуж против ее воли, и девушка всеми способами пытается избежать этого брака.

programme.title: Женский доктор
programme.desc: Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

programme.title: После зимы
programme.desc: Все неприятности свалились на медсестру Ольгу Грабину в один день. Её уволили из клиники, а затем выяснилось, что муж ей изменяет, дочка Лера беременна, а другая - Варя - собирается стать актрисой, вместо запланированного поступления в медицинский на стоматолога. Ольга пытается привыкнуть жить одна и найти новую работу. А еще нужно поддержать и помирить дочек, решить их проблемы и принять их выбор, не дать корыстной любовнице мужа отобрать имущество, полагающееся Варе и Лере. И, самое сложное, понять себя и решить: подать на развод или попытаться вернуть мужа..."

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: The documentary film "Sisters" tells the story of humanity, compassion, and the power of support that help Ukrainians overcome the pain of loss during war. The film shows the stories of women who, having experienced their own tragedy, turned their pain into a good deed. Twin sisters from Dnipro launched a volunteer project "Search with Love and Hope" to care for the graves of Ukrainian soldiers whose families cannot come to the burial sites. The film is not only a story of loss, but also of deep solidarity and gratitude. It reminds us that even in the most difficult times, Ukrainians stick together, support each other, and honor those who gave their lives for freedom.

programme.title: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire
programme.desc: In 450 AD, Rome is a mere shadow of its former self. Gone is the superior civilisation and great expanses of land. Now, Roman rulers are at the mercy of their barbarian invaders, offering them power and territory in exchange for peace. In the midst of the Empire's low decline, three comrades rise in the ranks of the Roman military: Ricimer, Aegidius and Majorian, all competing for Imperial control. Majorian is the first to be named emperor, and Aegidius is made his prime general, but Ricimer, a soldier of barbarian descent, is the real puppet master. Eventually, any man who threatens his own authority, including his friends, will meet their bloody end at the edge of his sword.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire
programme.desc: Near the end of the third century, civil war has torn the empire apart and left its borders vulnerable to barbarian invasion. Romans living on the eastern and western frontiers, far from Rome, are left to defend themselves, which they do by building their own armies and naming their own emperors. As the Empire divides against itself, one extraordinary man rises from the rank of soldier to become emperor in Rome. His name is Aurelian, and with an unshakeable trust in the sun god, he fights back the barbarians who by now threaten Rome itself. Once he secures the great city, Aurelian pursues the rulers of the splinter empires: an eastern warrior queen and a proud western general. Defeating both, he reunites the empire in five short years, earning the title Restorer of the World. For a moment there is peace. But in 275 AD Aurelian is assassinated; his death is mourned by Romans across the empire, who know too well the scarcity of greatness in their rulers.

programme.title: Missing in Alaska
programme.desc: The Alaska Triangle, a region in northwest Alaska, has more unsolved missing person cases than anywhere else in the world. Over 20,000 people have vanished in the past 50 years alone. Who or what's behind these cases is unknown. Some believe it's the work of local predators or simply the rugged, dangerous terrain, but legends thrive in Alaska, and the ominous history of disappearances in the area has drawn comparisons to the Bermuda Triangle. Working together with local experts and eyewitnesses, our team of investigators will go case-by-case to gather evidence, conduct tests, examine history and explore local myths to determine the most viable explanation for the disappearances, all while trying to understand the sinister mystery that is the Alaska Triangle.

programme.title: Lost Relic Hunters
programme.desc: Lost Relic Hunters follows the work of one of the world's most prolific collectors of antiquities, Hamilton White, and his long-time friend and business partner, Carl Cookson. The intrepid duo are back on the trail of some truly astonishing relics and historical pieces, which, if authenticated, will potentially change our understanding of some of the most iconic periods of British and European history. Aided in their adventures by cultural and art historian Dr Janina Ramirez, Lost Relic Hunters sees Carl and Hamilton journey to breath-taking locations around the world including Venice, Istanbul, Barcelona, Jerusalem and the Pyrenees, in their quest to authenticate the rare and precious antiquities from Hamilton's collection.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: How the Earth Was Made
programme.desc: With the help of expert geologists and various scientists, How the Earth Was Made is a remarkable documentary series that examines the powerful forces and events that have shaped our planet. Using stunning, computer generated cinematography, viewers are transported back billions of years to learn how our planet was formed, and the drastically different changes it has witnessed. Each episode focusses on a different location to explore how it has adapted and adjusted over millions of years, such as the Grand Canyon, Mount Everest, the Sahara desert and the Mariana Trench.

programme.title: Brad Meltzer's Decoded
programme.desc: What if the history you knew was only half the story? Brad Meltzer's Decoded investigates the other half: the secret history of the symbols and codes that surround us everyday. Best-selling author Brad Meltzer has been writing novels for more than a decade. He has studied and written about some of the most revered institutions and documents in human history, including the U.S. Supreme Court, the Presidency, the Secret Service, Wall Street and the Bible. Brad has assembled a team to investigate the countless clues and theories uncovered through his years of research, but unexplored until now. From the dollar bill to the first Presidential Codes, the hidden messages of the Statue of Liberty and the ciphers protecting the location of lost Confederate gold, the team uncovers the truth behind history's most provocative secrets.

Once he secures the great city, Aurelian pursues the rulers of the splinter empires: an eastern warrior queen and a proud western general. Defeating both, he reunites the empire in five short years, earning the title Restorer of the World. For a moment there is peace. But in 275 AD Aurelian is assassinated; his death is mourned by Romans across the empire, who know too well the scarcity of greatness in their rulers.

programme.title: Missing in Alaska
programme.desc: The Alaska Triangle, a region in northwest Alaska, has more unsolved missing person cases than anywhere else in the world. Over 20,000 people have vanished in the past 50 years alone. Who or what's behind these cases is unknown. Some believe it's the work of local predators or simply the rugged, dangerous terrain, but legends thrive in Alaska, and the ominous history of disappearances in the area has drawn comparisons to the Bermuda Triangle. Working together with local experts and eyewitnesses, our team of investigators will go case-by-case to gather evidence, conduct tests, examine history and explore local myths to determine the most viable explanation for the disappearances, all while trying to understand the sinister mystery that is the Alaska Triangle.

programme.title: Lost Relic Hunters
programme.desc: Lost Relic Hunters follows the work of one of the world's most prolific collectors of antiquities, Hamilton White, and his long-time friend and business partner, Carl Cookson. The intrepid duo are back on the trail of some truly astonishing relics and historical pieces, which, if authenticated, will potentially change our understanding of some of the most iconic periods of British and European history. Aided in their adventures by cultural and art historian Dr Janina Ramirez, Lost Relic Hunters sees Carl and Hamilton journey to breath-taking locations around the world including Venice, Istanbul, Barcelona, Jerusalem and the Pyrenees, in their quest to authenticate the rare and precious antiquities from Hamilton's collection.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: How the Earth Was Made
programme.desc: With the help of expert geologists and various scientists, How the Earth Was Made is a remarkable documentary series that examines the powerful forces and events that have shaped our planet. Using stunning, computer generated cinematography, viewers are transported back billions of years to learn how our planet was formed, and the drastically different changes it has witnessed. Each episode focusses on a different location to explore how it has adapted and adjusted over millions of years, such as the Grand Canyon, Mount Everest, the Sahara desert and the Mariana Trench.

programme.title: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire
programme.desc: In 450 AD, Rome is a mere shadow of its former self. Gone is the superior civilisation and great expanses of land. Now, Roman rulers are at the mercy of their barbarian invaders, offering them power and territory in exchange for peace. In the midst of the Empire's low decline, three comrades rise in the ranks of the Roman military: Ricimer, Aegidius and Majorian, all competing for Imperial control. Majorian is the first to be named emperor, and Aegidius is made his prime general, but Ricimer, a soldier of barbarian descent, is the real puppet master. Eventually, any man who threatens his own authority, including his friends, will meet their bloody end at the edge of his sword.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens

programme.title: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire
programme.desc: In the middle of the fifth century, as the Empire fights a losing battle against its formidable barbarian opponents, one Roman named Orestes finds service in the court of Attila the Hun. Schooled in the strategy of his enemy, Orestes eventually makes his way back to Italy, determined to resurrect Rome. Naming his young son emperor, Orestes attempts to purify Rome of her barbarian influences. Yet he soon learns the sad truth, that without barbarians, there is no Rome. After hundreds of years of using the foreign invaders as mercenary soldiers, they outnumber the Romans, and the Empire can't afford to dismiss them. Though Orestes fights valiantly, he meets his end at the hands of the leader of the barbarian mercenaries, Odacer, an event that spells the end of Rome in 476 AD. The last emperor, just a boy, is sent into exile, and Odacer proclaims there is no need for a new emperor, as the Roman Empire is no more.

programme.title: Doomsday: 10 Ways the World Will End
programme.desc: Theories of how the world will meet its end in this doomsday documentary as we follow scientist Trevor S. Valle as he hypothesises with others through the series. Looking into how the human race will be wiped out with each episode examining a different theory of how the planet will be destroyed. From being swallowed by a black hole, bombed by meteorites or overcome by aliens the series covers the most popular theories. An intriguing and interesting watch that will have you questioning how things out of this world could see the end of the earth.

programme.title: Lost Gold of WW2
programme.desc: It is the last great mystery of WWII. The fabled Yamashita Treasure, a massive stash of gold bars and rubies worth billions, reportedly dumped in a cave by Japanese soldiers retreating from allied forces. While the fortune has become a legend, many experts claim there is no evidence it ever existed. Now, a dedicated group of investigators are resurrecting the dangerous search, using cutting-edge technology in pursuit of the truth, and unimaginable wealth.

programme.title: UFO Files
programme.desc: In the search for life beyond our planet, this documentary investigates areas on earth that are said to have had UFO activity, conspiracy theories and phenomenons. From going off of tales that have been told and spread through generations and or cultures to personal experiences where sighting have occurred the series covers the super natural phenomenon that is life beyond earth.

programme.desc: Утренняя новостная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Азия 360
programme.desc: Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР, и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно, живут в кишлаках и ездят на ослах, мечтают переехать в Россию и работать там, пьют только зеленый чай и едят плов и мясо, притесняют людей других национальностей? Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. Чарли только и делает, что заводит любовные интрижки, а Алан всеми силами пытается от него не отстать. В свободное от амурных приключений время братья воспитывают десятилетнего сынишку Алана Джейка.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. programme.title: Я обещаю молчать
programme.desc: Взрослую жизнь Даши трудно назвать счастливой — мать уговорила её выйти за Игоря, сына своей подруги, который пьёт и распускает руки. Ей уже за тридцать, а ни карьеры, ни настоящей любви, ни детей у неё нет. В студенческие годы она оставила в роддоме девочку и с тех пор живёт с чувством вины. Но в один момент Даша решает всё изменить — она увольняется с работы, уходит от мужа и отправляется на поиски своей дочери. Девочку удочерили супруги Савины — Алексей и Ирина. Они назвали её Машей. Даша устраивается гувернанткой в их дом. Вскоре выясняется, что Ирина неизлечимо больна, и она берёт с Даши слово, что Маша никогда не узнает правду о своём рождении.

programme.title: Танец мотылька
programme.desc: Карина мечтает о танцевальной карьере, но работает фабричной швеёй в маленьком шахтерском городе Рудогорске, где самой большой перспективой для героини является замужество с другом детства Геной. Дочери пожилого шахтера, которая живет под гнетом злобной мачехи и в тени сводной сестры, почти невозможно осуществить свою амбициозную мечту. Владелец шахты, где работает отец Карины, устраивает концерт в честь юбилея предприятия и судьба дарит девушке шанс: в город приезжает столичный диджей Ник и танцевальный ансамбль \"Цирцея\". Главный хореограф ансамбля замечает талант Карины и дает ей роль в своем танцевальном шоу. Девушка обретает не только карьерные перспективы, но и любовь диджея. Однако планы героини внезапно рушатся после взрыва на шахте, где работает ее отец. Карине предстоит пройти долгий путь, чтобы осуществить мечту всей своей жизни и разыскать диджея Ника...

programme.title: Госпожа Фазилет и ее дочери
programme.desc: Госпожа Фазилет после того, как потеряла мужа, одна воспитывает двух дочек. Вся жизнь Фазилет прошла в сожалениях, поэтому теперь ее вкладом в будущее стала младшая дочь Эдже. Но самым большим препятствием на пути матери является старшая дочь Хазан, которая несмотря на свою изысканную красоту ведет себя по-мальчишески и не ладит с матерью. Семья Эймен богата, могущественна, у них особняк на берегу Босфора, и однажды их пути пересекаются с Фазилет и ее дочерьми. Богатство Эймен даже превосходит мечты Фазилет. После знакомства с ними изменится не только жизнь Эдже, но и Хазан, которая влюбится в Синана Эймена, избалованного сына семьи.

programme.title: Балтия
programme.desc: Еженедельная информационная программа "Балтия" – непредвзятый взгляд на происходящее в Эстонии, Латвии и Литве. События, явления и люди в репортажах корреспондентов Настоящего Времени, работающих в регионе. Точная и беспристрастная информация, все точки зрения о происходящем в каждой из трех стран, входящих в Евросоюз и военный блок НАТО.

programme.title: Главное
programme.desc: Ежедневная информационная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Последний богатырь: Посланник Тьмы
programme.desc: Иван наконец обрел силушку богатырскую, злой чародей Роголеб повержен, и теперь все Белогорье готовится к пиру на весь мир: Иван и Василиса собираются праздновать свадьбу, решая типичные для почти любой пары молодоженов проблемы. В каком платье пойти под венец невесте? Кольца — простые или волшебные? Свадебное путешествие — на куриных ногах или в ступе? В самый разгар приготовлений к празднику зло снова напоминает о себе: Василиса похищена, и в пылу погони Иван и его друзья оказываются в современной Москве. Для жителей Белогорья это — волшебный мир, в котором люди перемещаются на странных колесницах, разговаривают с плоскими дощечками и не в состоянии отличить настоящую магию от дешевой детской игрушки. Но, как выясняется, и в этом мире, бок о бок с обычными людьми, неплохо устроились герои старых сказок, и с их помощью у Ивана есть шанс окончательно победить древнюю Тьму.

programme.title: Голое влечение
programme.desc: Скандальный цикл передач, в которых люди находят потенциальных спутников жизни, обнаженные тела которых им показывают. Затем они должны будут сами раздеться и сделать выбор.

programme.title: Disco Elysium: Битва за сценой
programme.desc: Видеоигра Disco Elysium вышла в 2019 году. Отличные продажи, престижные награды — это был громкий успех. Главный герой документального фильма \"Disco Elysium: битва за сценой\", геймер, хочет встретиться с создателями игры. Однако постепенно перед ним открывается неожиданная правда о любимой игре… Автор фильма — режиссёр, сценарист и продюсер Виктория Каськова. Сотрудничала с National Geographic, Discovery, BBC и Channel 4.

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: Hosted by Erin Burnett, an expert in political science and economics, OutFront is an hour-long news programme examining the latest stories from the US and further afield. Broadcast live from either the New York studio or live on location from the site of a breaking story, the show features insightful opinions from informed guests. With expert analysis from CNN's correspondents and analysis from the show's panel, Erin Burnett OutFront dissects the stories of the day, leaving no stone unturned. Burnett, a former financial analyst for Goldman Sachs, uses her forthright approach to engage interviewees in honest discussion.

programme.desc: Anderson Cooper delves into the day's news, looking beyond the broadcast to give his take, prompting us to re-think what we hear in the headlines. The show has won an absolute plethora of awards over the years, including GLAAD Media and Emmy awards.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Total DramaRama
programme.desc: Total DramaRama is canadian animated comedy series, spin-off of Total Drama, all characters are already well-known and loved by the audience. This time Duncan, Gwen, Courtney, Izzy, Noah, Bridgette and the rest find themselves in the past as kids and their adventures take place in kindergarten. The strict Chef Hatchet is there to keep his eye on them. Any harmless idea of the kids turns out to be a total disaster, they are irrepressible in producing new ideas on how to have fun. the kids are discussing every single decision and plan in front of the cameras just like their adult versions, being a part of a reality show.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Lana Longbeard
programme.desc: Lana is a super-feisty, forward-thinking and passionate 11-year-old girl, who is also the heir to her father's adventuring ship, the Mighty Windbreaker. Along with her captain dad and his diverse crew (an orc, a dwarf, a barbarian and a cyclops), she sails across the Ten Realms, dreaming of becoming one of the greatest adventurers of all time. But first, she must overcome some challenging obstacles: impulsivity, stubbornness, extreme curiosity, disdain for rules … and a love of pancakes. All the best things about her!

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Ninjago: Dragons Rising
programme.desc: Computer-animated epic fantasy superhero sequel series. It's dragons versus Photac beasts in the streets of Imperium, but the Claws stop Lloyd and Wyldfyre's efforts to free the escaped dragons as Sora and Arin search for Riyu. The young dragon's spark would allow Sora to shut down the Photacs for good - unfortunately, the Teen Protection Force brings him before the Empress... Meanwhile, Nya and Kai reunite under mysterious circumstances and face an apparition.

programme.title: Clarence
programme.desc: Follow the daily adventures of a 10-year-old boy named Clarence, and his two best friends Sumo and Jeff. Clarence lives with his mother Mary and her boyfriend Chad in the fictional town of Aberdale, and he is optimistic, curious, honest and quirky boy, who sees the best in everyone and gets himself in a variety of funny situations and everyday problems, which he solves with lots of imagination and with the help from his friends.

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Animated comedy following the adventures of Craig and his two friends Kelsey and JP. The Stump Kids head over to the Elder Rock to ask the Elders something, only to discover that they have been trapped underneath their rock for five days after their support gave way. Not wanting their parents to come, Craig and Kelsey try to free them while JP fills in at Mark's job - meanwhile, the Elders livestream their struggle as Creek Kids from all over watch on.

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Animated comedy following the adventures of Craig and his two friends Kelsey and JP. While playing at Craig's house, Kelsey accidentally lodges a sword into the wall and destroys some of it - her father Neil is upset and takes the sword away as punishment. To prove Kelsey's 'worthitude', Craig and JP put her through a series of hero trials to reclaim her sword, but she soon learns that this is not enough to sway her father.

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Animated comedy following the adventures of Craig and his two friends Kelsey and JP. In trying to uncover what caused the Ancients of the Creek to disband following a game of Capture the Flag, Craig realises that their map perfectly lines up with his own and ventures with Kelsey and JP to look for the remainder of the old Creek - they believe that they have found information as to where it is, but in order to get it, they need to go to Jason's backyard.

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Animated comedy following the adventures of Craig and his two friends Kelsey and JP. Craig is jealous of the fact that Kelsey and JP have pets to call their own - wanting a pet, he is approached by former Fredite Brigid to join her three-step training programme so that he can own a dog. When nothing seems to be working out for him, the Stump Kids slowly begin to realise that Brigid is taking advantage of them by pampering her.

programme.title: Lana Longbeard
programme.desc: Lana is a super-feisty, forward-thinking and passionate 11-year-old girl, who is also the heir to her father's adventuring ship, the Mighty Windbreaker. Along with her captain dad and his diverse crew (an orc, a dwarf, a barbarian and a cyclops), she sails across the Ten Realms, dreaming of becoming one of the greatest adventurers of all time. But first, she must overcome some challenging obstacles: impulsivity, stubbornness, extreme curiosity, disdain for rules … and a love of pancakes. All the best things about her!

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Adventure Time is an American fantasy animated television series that shows a 12-year-old boy Finn and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old (in dog years) dog Jake with magical powers living in Lands of Ooo in post-apocalyptic world. They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Total DramaRama
programme.desc: Total DramaRama is canadian animated comedy series, spin-off of Total Drama, all characters are already well-known and loved by the audience. This time Duncan, Gwen, Courtney, Izzy, Noah, Bridgette and the rest find themselves in the past as kids and their adventures take place in kindergarten. The strict Chef Hatchet is there to keep his eye on them. Any harmless idea of the kids turns out to be a total disaster, they are irrepressible in producing new ideas on how to have fun. the kids are discussing every single decision and plan in front of the cameras just like their adult versions, being a part of a reality show.

programme.desc: Gumball sets out to solve the mystery of who stuffed Principal Brown into his locker. / Gumball and Darwin's harmless pranks on Dad spiral hopelessly out of control. / Gumball and Darwin's martial arts costumes make them a laughing stock at school. / Gumball is traumatised when accidentally kissed on the mouth by his Grandma JoJo. / Gumball and Darwin are invited to a high school party and have to bring a date! / Gumball and Darwin unsuccessfully attempt to get a refund for their computer game. / Gumball discovers that Bobert is planning to take over his identity and replace him! / Gumball and Darwin barely survive a school picnic in the Forest of Doom. / Gumball sets out to win his Dad back by winning a blindfolded "dumb" race.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Rose Wilson escapes from prison defeating the Titans with cool one liners. Only Raven is immune to Rose's insults and the two decide to hang out and do cool stuff together. / When Beast Boy declares the Earth is a pancake, the Titans set sail to find out. / When the Titans realize they have not seen Silkie for a long time, they take turns guessing what happened to him. / The Titans organise a competition where boys and girls face each other.

At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The citizens of Elmore are feeling down because it's January so Gumball and Anais invent a new holiday called Sluzzle Tag. / In Biology class Gumball and Darwin are waiting for a butterfly to emerge from its chrysalis. / After Gumball and Darwin have too much sugary cereal they begin thinking about the mysteries of the universe. / Gumball Darwin and Anais discover that Banana Joe's mom paints pictures which predict the future. / When Mr Small shows a health and safety video in class Darwin becomes obsessed with the idea of keeping the Wattersons safe. / Anais throws a party but no-one shows up as she has no friends or social skills. / Alan is so good-natured that Gumball feels compelled to make him lose his temper. / Things aren't going Gumball's way at school so he assumes there must be a Secret Society...

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Amazing World of Gumball revolves around the life of Gumball Watterson, a 12-year-old cat who attends middle school in the fictional city of Elmore. Accompanied by his adoptive goldfish brother and best friend Darwin, he frequently finds himself involved in various shenanigans around the city, during which he interacts with his other family members - sister Anais and parents Nicole and Richard - and an extended supporting cast of characters. With relatable themes and a unique cast of characters, The Amazing World of Gumball exemplifies the funny, amazing, sweet and optimistic side of kids' everyday life. Injected with a good deal of humor and unpredictable nonsense, Gumball's world reflects the modern family and everyday issues that kids understand.

Minu parima sõbra pruut
programme.desc: USA 2008 romantiline komöödia Lavastaja:Howard Deutch Osades:Kate Hudson, Dane Cook, Jason Biggs Tank (Dane Cook) on meister naiste võrgutamise ja solvamise alal, kellest on saanud selle ala proff. Kui mõni kutt maha jäetakse, palkab ta Tanki, et see viiks ta eks-pruudi elu kõige jubedamale kohtamisele, mis oleks sedavõrd jube, et saadaks tüdruku jooksujalu tagasi hüljatud peika käte vahele. Kui sama juhtub Tanki parima sõbra Dustiniga (Jason Biggs), pakub ta loomulikult kohe abi? kohates seeläbi oma elu suurimat väljakutset. Alexis (Kate Hudson) osutub nimelt tüdrukuks, kes Tanki blufist läbi näeb ning õige pea on külmavereline proff täielikus segaduses: ühelt poolt peaks olema ustav Dustinile, samas aga ei suuda ta kuidagi alla suruda tundeid oma parima sõbra pruudi vastu.

programme.title: Killerid
programme.desc: USA 2010 komöödia Lavastaja: Robert Luketic Osades: Katherine Heigl, Ashton Kutcher, Tom Selleck, Catherine O'Hara Spencer Aimes (Ashton Kutcher) on täiesti tavaline valitsuse superpalgamõrvar, kelle elu keerleb Euroopa eksootiliste klubide, maitselagedate sportautode ja veelgi maitsetumate naiste ümber. Kohates Jen Kornfeldti (Katherine Heigl), kaunist ja valusast lahkuminekust toibuvat arvutispetsi, on Spencer leidnud tõelise armastuse ning vahetab rahvusvahelise karjääri suurima heameelega koduse õndsuse vastu. Kolm aastat hiljem naudivad Spencer ja Jen endiselt oma täiuslikku abielu, seda kuni Spenceri 30. sünnipäeva hommikuni, mil noored saavad teada, et Spenceri eest on välja pandud tõeliselt kopsakas pearaha. Mis veelgi hullem, palgamõrvarid on õnnelikku paarikest jälitanud aastaid ning võivad olla kes tahes: sõbrad, naabrid, müüja toidupoes, isegi üle tänava liipav vanamees. Spencerit ja Jeni ootab pöörane põgenemine. Nende paradiisisarnane äärelinnaelu muutub tõeliseks paranoiaks. Kes on mõrtsukas ja miks Spencer sihikule võeti, see tuleb alles välja selgitada, lisaks päästa abielu, sehkendada tüütute sugulaste ja naabritega ning... lihtsalt ellu jääda.

programme.title: Hoodie
programme.desc: "Hoodie" on superkangelase lugu täiesti tavalisest poisist, kellel on erakordne parkuuri talent ja õiglustunne. Kui kolm naabruskonna last Flo, Basim ja Kenza avastavad Pieteri talendi ja motivatsiooni, ühinevad nad ootamatuks superkangelaste tiimiks nimega tiim Hoodie. Neid ühendab üks eesmärk - vabastada naabruskond ülekohtust.
